direction.content_form: An overhead painted gathering encloses a central invitation; selected fresh photographic details interrupt the drawing rather than becoming little documentary cards.
direction.whole_expression_style: A deliberately constructed plan-view assembly: an open horseshoe of shared bowls, stools, bent listening bodies and a lap hand drum. Broad digital painted silhouettes connect them, while a rice-and-spring-greens dish and drum-skin crop cut across the same contour.
direction.reference_transfer: vi-grandfather: a large drawn contour and photographic fragments can divide pictorial labor; make an enclosing communal shape instead of nested heads, scattered family photos or manuscript texture. vi-anne: use overlap boundaries to lead from image to copy, without its rectangular sequence.

layout.large_relationship: The horseshoe crosses top and both sides and remains open at lower left. Identity and schedule form an offset inner hub; place and access follow the right interior edge, while participation returns through the open end. The painted gathering never becomes an empty tabletop for a standard template.
layout.alignment: Centered identity inside the opening, with left-aligned schedule/access groups around it; rectangular text remains horizontal even where contour direction bends.
layout.visible_reading_route: Enclosing painted gathering → central identity → schedule immediately above → right venue/entry → lower-right purchase/participation → lower-left cup and lingering invitation along the open end.

direction.typography: A contemporary Korean serif title gives the inner hub a hospitable voice, without a vintage masthead. English sits tightly beneath it; clear sans practical groups are larger where they must bridge the enclosing image. Avoid circular letter paths and rotated sentences.
direction.image: Top-down, nonliteral montage with recognizable shared rice dishes and percussion among adults sitting and listening. Photographic details are large enough to alter the enclosing contour; their edges are cut cleanly into paint. No copied faces, historical photos, autograph marks or source silhouette.
direction.material: Broad opaque digital paint plus clean contemporary photographic incursions; visible brush shape is pictorial editing, not fabricated age or proof of physical craft.
direction.color: Aubergine, pale apricot and cool celadon with natural photographic tones. Keep the inner hub pale and quiet but irregularly bounded by active silhouettes; dark practical text stays off brush ridges and photo noise.
direction.emotion: Sheltering and communal, with a lively enclosure rather than nostalgic family memorial atmosphere.
direction.closest_direction_contrast: Against M1, the overhead enclosure collects information around an inner hub; it does not use diminishing scale or a near-to-far narrative path.

copy_groups.purpose: Schedule above the hub, following the inner edge
Location/access on the right inner opening
Cost and participation returning along the lower opening
Cup reminder at the open end

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added copy,logos,watermark,QR or pseudo-print.
One separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster per role; not a stretched/cropped portrait,contact sheet or room mockup.
Five genuinely distinct complete image/editing/space/type systems and impressions beyond material,scene-object,palette or viewpoint substitution alone.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction, not type/whitespace-only,tiny texture/icon or glyph-model loophole.

An approachable adult neighborhood evening with seasonal food and local music coherently connected as one event. All supplied practical participation information readable at usage720. No identifiable real business or performer promotion.

Exclude the passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information template with subordinate pictures. Small pictures,thin texture,gradient,grids,font-only swaps or photographic/empty-room dressing of blank text-bearing planes do not cure the unchanged whole relation. Gothic font,negative space and coherent image-led scenes themselves are not banned. No scoped composition override.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
